members.name: receivesEventsInView
members.signature: static func receivesEventsInView(_ receivesEventsInView: Bool) -> GameControllerEventHandlingOptions
members.comment:
A Boolean option that determines whether events are delivered
exclusively through the GameController framework.

If `true`, events are delivered both through the Game Controller
framework and as SwiftUI events to your app's views and gesture
recognizers.

If `false`, events are delivered **exclusively** through the Game
Controller framework.
